data.name: Auth0 Tenant
data.description: Identity provider issuing flow-specific scoped tokens

threats.title: Forged or stolen token
threats.description: An attacker presents a stolen or forged access token to impersonate a user or service.
threats.mitigation: Validate signature, issuer, audience and expiry. Use short-lived tokens, PKCE and sender-constrained tokens.

threats.title: Scope escalation in token request
threats.description: The attacker alters the requested scope so the issued token has broader rights than the flow needs.
threats.mitigation: Fix allowed scopes per Auth0 client and API, and reject any scope outside the whitelist.

threats.title: Token leakage
threats.description: Tokens leak through logs, URLs, browser storage or a TLS downgrade.
threats.mitigation: Enforce TLS, use Http Only and Secure cookies, avoid tokens in URLs, and redact logs.
